items.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
items.description: Trump cites his "very good relationship" with North Korea's leader in deciding to downsize the exercises.

items.title: Trump envoy Kushner arrives in Israel after rare Hamas talks on Gaza peace plan
items.description: US President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is expected to meet Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu later on Monday.

items.title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
items.description: A 14-year-old child was among four others injured, the acting governor of Russia's Belgorod region says.

items.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
items.description: Some 53 people were killed and thousands displaced by the earthquake, which struck early on Saturday.

items.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
items.description: The outbreak was already the fastest growing on record, caused by a rare species of Ebola called Bundibugyo.

items.title: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
items.description: The authorities allege they were involved in an insurrection plot but the leading opposition candidate says there was an attempt on his life.

items.title: Two dead and hundreds evacuated after twin fires break out on Greek island
items.description: About 200 firefighters worked to keep the fires from converging on Salamina, with one now under control.
